value.rationale: The alternating commutator-rank spectrum is a structural Lie-algebra invariant already linked to coadjoint representation theory. This theorem turns that natural invariant into the full nonzero rank-one Nijenhuis operator census on infinitely many stem two-step algebras, separates square-zero and non-square-zero operators, and supplies a closed free-Lie family across dimensions and finite fields. The part \(c=1\) already known is explicitly credited. This is a coherent natural parameter-space classification rather than a single finite experiment or cosmetic reparametrization.
